name: qol-skills
description: Claude Code skills for the qol-tools ecosystem (qol-tray host app, plugins, shared libs, CI workflows, and general engineering practices), split into fine-grained plugins for per-plugin toggling.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-alt-tab
plugins.description: Specialist agent and skills for the qol-tray alt-tab plugin: GPUI window list, X11/macOS preview capture, AX/CG discovery, daemon lifecycle, settings UI, release flow, and a SubagentStop hook that auto-curates agent MEMORY.md.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-launcher
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray launcher plugin: GPUI launcher architecture, discovery/ranking, and release flow.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-pointz
plugins.description: Skills for the PointZ pair: the qol-pointz desktop daemon (input injection; qol-tray owns discovery and pairing) and the Flutter mobile client.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-keyremap
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray key remap plugin (macOS and Windows): the event-tap daemon, rule kinds, and per-app exclusions.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-lights
plugins.description: Specialist agent and skills for the qol-tray lights plugin: backend adapters, the ZNP serial stack in libs/zigbee, the daemon/runtime split, native settings, and a SubagentStop hook that auto-curates agent MEMORY.md.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-os-themes
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray OS themes plugin (Linux and Windows): cursor effects, native theme control, daemon lifecycle, and platform adapters.

plugins.name: qol-shot
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-shot plugin: screenshot and screen-recording capture, native overlays, output and clipboard on Linux, macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-window-actions
plugins.description: Skills for Window Actions: geometry, minimize/restore, monitor movement, continuous glide, platform behavior, and diagnostics.

plugins.name: qol-tray
plugins.description: Host-app plugin for qol-tray: a backend specialist agent plus deep skills for core architecture (qol-tray-core), Rust internals, data migrations, the Profile feature, dev recompile, release flow, and apps-testing. Includes hooks for dev-recompile context, uncited architecture claims, and reflecting agent learnings.

plugins.name: qol-workflow
plugins.description: Cross-cutting workflow conventions for any qol-tools repo: commit message conventions (with the no-attribution hard rule), git push and worktree workflows, and universal coding guidelines. Ships PreToolUse hooks that (1) inject commit context, (2) block AI-attribution lines in commits and pull request bodies, (3) block branch-creation/switching inside a qol-* main clone (worktrees-only rule), (4) deny per-tool `match` branches added to shared CLI-sessions code (the naming/backends law), (5) refuse pull request titles the repository commit-msg gate would refuse, (6) remind the agent to start the pull request watcher (bin/pr-watch.cjs) after gh pr create, ready, merge --auto, or a push to a branch with an open pull request.

plugins.name: qol-langs
plugins.description: Personal-experience wells for languages and frameworks used in qol-tools: rust-conventions and gpui-conventions. Workspace-specific style and gotchas, not canonical library docs; for those, use context7.

plugins.name: qol-project
plugins.description: Project-level conventions for the qol-tools ecosystem: mission invariants, org layout, shared CI/release contracts, cross-platform architecture guardrails, shared library placement, plugin templates, and clean OS development environments for portability validation. Ships PreToolUse hooks that block architecture-contract violations plus a UserPromptSubmit hook that reminds Claude to consult qol-mission when prompts mention design/scope/issue terms in a qol-tools repo.

plugins.name: qol-trace-discipline
plugins.description: Cross-cutting qol trace discipline: reminds agents to consider new or richer qol trace targets whenever code changes touch behavior, persistence, runtime flows, tests, or bug investigations.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-controllers
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray Controllers plugin (Linux and Windows): the gpui gamepad field, hardware profiles, Linux evdev and Bluetooth diagnostics, signal semantics, and rumble testing.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-bluetooth
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-bluetooth plugin: adapter and device control, discovery, and reliable reconnection on Linux (BlueZ), macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-cli-sessions
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-cli-sessions plugin: live CLI session overview, per-tool interpretation, and attention status.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-removeapp
plugins.description: Skills for the plugin-removeapp plugin: leftover attribution, package-manager guards, and safe identity-checked removal.

plugins.name: qol-voice
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-voice plugin: speech capture, engine-neutral transcription, turn coordination, and routing to terminal sessions.

plugins.name: qol-debug
plugins.description: Use when asked to locate, hunt for bugs, or find security vulnerabilities in a qol-tools repo (qol-monorepo, qol-skills) - first-pass identification, evidence-gathering, and high-confidence reporting without fixing. Triggers on "locate bugs", "find bugs", "bug hunt", "first pass", "hunt for defects", "report back what you found", "find security vulnerabilities", "security review", "hunt for vulnerabilities", "find exploits", or any read-only debugging or security sweep. Covers baseline verification (clippy + full test suite), live qol-dev session log mining, recent-fix and newest-feature prioritization, the static bug-shape and security scan catalogs, per-suspect source verification, multi-perspective review for high-value targets, guest-VM confirmation of runtime findings, and the report template that ships only high-confidence findings.

plugins.name: qol-sessions
plugins.description: Architect-to-implementer feature loop for independent terminals with event-signalled rounds, explicit closure, and a canonical final report.

plugins.name: qol-adversarial-test
plugins.description: Adversarial testing discipline for real application surfaces: isolated baselines, invariant-driven attack storms, preserved failures, regression-first fixes, live verification, and machine-readable reports.

plugins.name: qol-code-review
plugins.description: Code review skill with read-only review orchestration, domain-focused reviewer agents, contextual quick wins, severity/confidence gates, adversarial passes, and machine-parseable synthesis.

plugins.name: qol-workflow-nodes
plugins.description: Personal productivity rule for KMRH47: when work repeats or performance work needs before/after evidence, convert it into deterministic workflow nodes, measurement ledgers, explicit inputs, outputs, reports, and composable orchestrators instead of burning human memory and agent tokens.

plugins.name: qol-memory
plugins.description: Long-context memory for agent sessions: ask settled facts from prior sessions, capture new ones, and get the units that landed since your last session in this directory.
